The '''lodge of the Canted Circle''' was located in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] and served as the headquarters of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], during [[Larsh Hill]]'s initiation ceremony, an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] was launched against several members of the Order by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by [[Pax Teem]], though the main target had been [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]].<ref name="DP" />
